prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one original, professionally art-directed logo concept for "Helseark", an open-source offline personal and family health archive. It preserves source documents and reviewed health records over a lifetime, owned by the individual. Brand qualities: calm, trustworthy, durable, humane, independent. This is a logo exploration, not a finished identity. Render a single polished horizontal symbol-and-wordmark lockup centered on a plain warm white background, with ample whitespace. Flat vector-like solid shapes, crisp edges, deliberate optical balance, memorable silhouette, reproducible at small sizes. Exact brand text: "Helseark" (H e l s e a r k). No other text, no slogans, no labels, no mockups, no paper textures, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no stethoscopes, no ECG lines, no generic medical crosses, no stock-logo look. Direction 6, QUIET ARK: an evocative minimal abstract ark made from a single broad U-shaped bowl/boat supporting one simple folded upright page like a sail. The silhouette should feel like a vessel that safely carries a lifetime of records. Dark midnight navy with one restrained muted sea-green accent on the page. A distinctive softly squared contemporary sans-serif wordmark. Calm, protective without shields or locks, maritime metaphor kept abstract and timeless. Use just two or three bold shapes, no water lines, no anchors.
vectorization: Potrace 1.16, separate binary color masks, flat colors; original lettering traced to paths
